gizmo.title: Rārangi pāho pāpāho
gizmo.description: He rārangi pāho e whakaatu ana i ngā kaipāho ataata me te oro i tētahi tahora kaipāho + paeteha.

configure.title: Tūemi tīmatanga
configure.description: Te tau o te tūemi hei tīmatanga.

configure.title: Akoranga
configure.description: Te akoranga mō tēnei rārangi pāho (tohu tautuhi akoranga, URL rānei).

developer.title: Pāpāho
developer.description: Ngā ataata me te oro i te rārangi whakatangi. Kāore e whakatikaina ki konei: ka whakamahia e te whakahuahua whārangi kia mōhio ai ko ēhea paraka ka taea te whakataka ki roto.
